content_sections.heading: About IIT Dharwad Project Associate I
content_sections.text: According to the notice, IIT Dharwad is an Institute of National Importance created by an Act of Parliament in 2016. It is recruiting for these positions to meet the needs of a project in its Department of Computer Science and Engineering. The project is titled "Speech Technologies in Indian Languages", and its project code carries the reference MeitY-NLTM. The whole selection is described as an Online Selection Process for a temporary position.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a B. Tech/M. Tech degree in Computer Science Engineering, Electrical & Communication Engineering, or a related stream from an accredited institution. They must also meet any ONE of the following additional requirements: GATE qualification, or The Selection process is through a national-level examination conducted by IIT. The qualification must come from a recognized University/Institute. Age, qualification and experience will be considered as on the date of the Selection Process. The notice says strong programming skills and knowledge in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Signal Processing are preferable. The age must be not exceeding 35 years as on the date of the selection process. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Associate I position carries consolidated emoluments. The rate depends on the candidate's degree: The tenure of appointment is a maximum of 5 months. Selected candidates will have no claim on any regular position. They will also not receive the privileges available to the Institute's regular employees, such as housing, medical facility and other benefits.

content_sections.heading: IIT Dharwad Project Associate I Job Description
content_sections.text: Development of a real-time Language Identification System.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Dharwad Project Associate I
content_sections.text: Applications are made only through the online application form linked in the notice (see Important Links). Submit the form on or before 17 November 2026. Before the selection process, applicants should have the following ready: An online version of all original certificates Mark sheets (matriculation onwards) Experience certificate(s) Proof of monthly emoluments/salary drawn Other relevant documents, including one set of self-attested certificate(s)/document(s) An updated Curriculum Vitae For queries about the selection process, candidates may write to [email protected] . Queries about eligibility for the post or the interpretation of rules will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: Screening: all applications are screened first. Meeting the minimum eligibility does not guarantee shortlisting. IIT Dharwad reserves the right to screen and shortlist candidates by introducing higher benchmarks. Online interview: only shortlisted applicants will be called. Emails will be sent to all shortlisted candidates. The selection process is tentatively scheduled for 19 November 2026. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Selection Process.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Any changes to the schedule will be announced on the IIT Dharwad website.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate I vacancies has IIT Dharwad announced?
faq.answer: IIT Dharwad has announced 5 Project Associate I positions. The notice calls this number tentative.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Dharwad Project Associate I?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for IIT Dharwad Project Associate I?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B. Tech/M. Tech degree in Computer Science Engineering, Electrical & Communication Engineering, or a related stream from an accredited institution. They also need either GATE qualification or selection through a national-level examination conducted by IIT.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIT Dharwad Project Associate I?
faq.answer: The age must be not exceeding 35 years as on the date of the selection process.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IIT Dharwad Project Associate I?
faq.answer: PG candidates receive ₹31,000 per month and BE candidates receive ₹25,000 per month, each with 16% House Rent Allowance.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Project Associate I pay?
faq.answer: Yes. A 16% House Rent Allowance per month is paid in addition to the consolidated emoluments of ₹31,000 or ₹25,000.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for IIT Dharwad Project Associate I?
faq.answer: Fill in the online application form linked in the notice by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIT Dharwad Project Associate I?
faq.answer: Applications are screened first, and only shortlisted applicants are called for an online interview. The interview is tentatively scheduled for 19 November 2026, and shortlisted candidates will be informed by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIT Dharwad Project Associate I job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary project position with a tenure of a maximum of 5 months. Selected candidates will have no claim on any regular position.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the selection process?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the Selection Process.
